title: deringa dissecta
intro: Deringa dissecta, commonly known as African Spikerush, is a plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of wounds and infections. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic and anti-edematous properties, making it useful for relieving pain and reducing swelling. The bioactive constituents of Deringa dissecta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
